sections.title: nem parks in front of fog
sections.content: To say you won't do something, nem goes right in front of fog, exactly where it goes in front of any other verb you're negating — the infinitive after it doesn't change at all: Nem fogok dolgozni holnap ("I won't work tomorrow").

items.spanish: Károly nem fog segíteni ma este.
Attól tartok, nem fogunk mindent megoldani határidőre.
items.english: I'm afraid we won't solve everything by the deadline.

sections.title: One special case: a prefixed infinitive
sections.content: With a prefixed verb like elmegy, the prefix normally jumps to the OTHER side of a negated verb (Unit 22's nem megyek el). With fog + infinitive it works differently: the infinitive itself is never directly negated, only fog is — so the prefix has nowhere to jump to, and it just stays glued to the infinitive: Nem fogok elmenni ("I won't go"), not Nem el fogok menni.
